title: 第7章 重金寻狗
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

嗯……跟寻狗启示上的完全不一样。

谭筝有些遗憾。

不过心想也是，这么凑巧的事情，怎么会被她给碰上呢。

这狗看着还挺乖的，应该不会咬人吧？谭筝一边想着，一边慢吞吞地往外挪。

忽然，小黄狗朝她跑了过来，张口咬住了她的裤脚。

“诶诶诶，你干嘛！”

谭筝有些懵了，被动的被拽了出去。

“你是遇到了什么困难，需要我帮忙吗？”

小黄狗松开了她的裤脚，很通人性地嗷呜了一声。

理智告诉谭筝，她现在应该马上离开，抓紧时间搞钱，为后面几天的囤货做准备。

可当她看到小狗那双湿漉漉的眼睛时，又有些于心不忍。

“你带路吧，我跟你去。”谭筝叹了口气，无奈道。

小狗很高兴，立刻摇着尾巴在前面带路。

谭筝跟着七拐八拐，来到了一个废弃的家具厂附近。

“你带我来这干嘛啊？”

小黄狗朝里头叫了两声，一只大黑狗跑了出来。

一大一小两只狗，围着谭筝转。

“啥意思啊？肚子饿了？我看看这周围有没有超市，给你们买几根火腿肠吃。”

正当谭筝专心致志研究地图的时候，小黄狗跳了起来，把她折叠在口袋里的寻狗启示扒拉了出来。

东西掉在地上，吸引了谭筝的注意力。

“别捣乱！”

彼此的谭筝还没看出小黄狗的用意，有些严肃地训斥了一声。

“呜呜——”

小黄狗委屈，用嘴巴叼起寻狗启示后，再用爪子拼命扒拉旁边的大黑狗。

“嗯？”谭筝这才反应过来。

把寻狗启示从小狗嘴巴里拿出来后，展开仔细看了看。

这这这！这上头印的，貌似就是眼前这头大黑狗啊！

谭筝有些不可置信，开始仔细核对特征，胸口处有白毛、尾巴受过伤，偏短一截、喊可乐会有反应……

“可乐？”

“汪汪汪！”

Page (1/3)

Hmm...it's completely different from the "Hunting for Dogs" revelation.

Tan Zheng felt a little regretful.

But I also thought, how could such a coincidence happen to her.

This dog seems quite well-behaved, he shouldn't bite people, right?Tan Zheng thought as he slowly moved out.

Suddenly, the little yellow dog ran towards her, opened its mouth and bit her trouser leg.

"Hey, hey, what are you doing!"

Tan Zheng was a little confused and was dragged out passively.

"Have you encountered any difficulties and need my help?"

The little yellow dog loosened her trousers and let out a humane cry.

She rationally told Tan Zheng that she should leave immediately and seize the time to get money to prepare for stocking up in the next few days.

But when she saw the puppy's wet eyes, she couldn't bear it.

"You lead the way, I'll go with you." Tan Zheng sighed and said helplessly.

The puppy was very happy and immediately led the way with his tail wagging.

Tan Zheng followed Qiguai and Baguai and arrived near an abandoned furniture factory.

"Why did you bring me here?"

The little yellow dog barked twice inside, and a big black dog ran out.

Two dogs, one big and one small, circled around Tan Zheng.

"What do you mean? Are you hungry? Let me see if there is a supermarket around here and buy you some ham sausages."

While Tan Zheng was concentrating on studying the map, the little yellow dog jumped up and pulled out the dog-finding revelation she had folded in her pocket.

Something fell to the ground, attracting Tan Zheng's attention.

"Don't cause trouble!"

Tan Zheng, who was talking to each other, hadn't seen the little yellow dog's intention yet, so he scolded him somewhat seriously.

"Woo-"

The little yellow dog was aggrieved. After picking up the dog-finding message in his mouth, he used his paws to pull the big black dog next to him.

"Huh?" Tan Zheng finally reacted.

After taking the dog-finding message out of the puppy's mouth, he unfolded it and looked at it carefully.

This, this, this!The thing printed on it seems to be the big black dog in front of me!

Tan Zheng was a little in disbelief, and began to check the features carefully. There were white hairs on the chest, the tail was injured, it was a little short, and it reacted to shouting Coke...

"Coke?"

"Woof woof woof!"
